_registration: Registered in experiments/ode_v2/CONTEXT.md and the three ODE rerun registrations it lists; its SHA-256 is pinned in experiments/ode_v2/registered_identities.json.

_rationale.rtol_atol: rtol 1e-8, atol 1e-10. At rtol 1e-6 the classifier's fixed-point bound (final derivative 1e-6) sat on the solver's noise floor and split converged fixed points in two; at 1e-8 they fall 10x inside it (results/audit/classifier_calibration.json vs classifier_calibration_rtol1e-8.json).
_rationale.t_max_t_tail: doubled from legacy with the tail kept at the final third, because lower Hill coefficients may settle more slowly; every trajectory records its tail range and final derivative
_rationale.attempts: RK45 first; a larger RK45 budget only if the first hit its cap; Radau only after a failure of any kind. Radau and BDF both succeeded on all 24 forced trajectories of the benchmark (results/audit/engine_timing.json); BDF was about twice as fast. Radau was chosen because it is an A- and L-stable implicit Runge-Kutta method of order 5, while BDF above order 2 is not A-stable; the benchmark did not decide between them.
